action.action-desc: Ms. Lee of Nevada (for herself and Mr. Horsford) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To terminate the Yucca Mountain licensing proceeding and require the Director of the Office of Management and Budget to submit to Congress a study on the economic viability and job-creating benefits of alternative uses of the Yucca Mountain site, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Jobs, Not Waste Act of 2026.

paragraph.text: The term appropriate committees of Congress means—

subparagraph.text: the Committee on Environment and Public Works of the Senate;
the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources of the Senate; and
the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives.

paragraph.text: The term Commission means the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
The term Secretary means the Secretary of Energy.
The term Yucca Mountain site has the meaning given the term in section 2 of the Nuclear Waste Policy Act of 1982 (42 U.S.C. 10101).

section.header: Termination of the Yucca Mountain licensing proceeding

subparagraph.text: Section 160 of the Nuclear Waste Policy Act of 1982 (42 U.S.C. 10172) is repealed.
The table of contents in section 1 of the Nuclear Waste Policy Act of 1982 (Public Law 97–425; 96 Stat. 2201, 101 Stat. 1330–255) is amended by striking the item relating to section 160.

paragraph.text: Public Law 107–200 (42 U.S.C. 10135 note; 116 Stat. 735) is repealed.

subsection.text: Effective on the date of enactment of this Act—

paragraph.text: the application for a construction authorization for a repository at the Yucca Mountain site filed with the Commission by the Secretary is withdrawn; and
the Commission licensing proceeding for the proposed repository at the Yucca Mountain site is terminated.

subsection.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, beginning on the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall not consider (or reconsider) the Yucca Mountain site for the location of a repository.
As soon as practicable after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall take all reasonable and necessary steps—

paragraph.text: to reclaim the Yucca Mountain site; and

to mitigate any significant adverse environmental impacts caused by site characterization and other activities associated with the filing of the application for a construction authorization referred to in subsection (b)(1).

section.header: Study on the economic benefit of alternative uses of the Yucca Mountain site
section.text: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall submit to the appropriate committees of Congress, and make available to the public, a study on the economic viability and job-creating benefits of alternative uses of the Yucca Mountain site as described in the report of the Government Accountability Office numbered GAO–11–847 and dated September 2011, including—

paragraph.text: defense activities, such as a command facility for unmanned aircraft systems;
